author: UmbreonMessiah
body:
Before Hand: Okay, I know this suggestion may be very hard to do, and may seem pointless to upgraded users, but I think it would be nice, especially for the non-upgraded players. 


Where I got this idea:  So, I was sitting around in a game as a spectator, since I couldn't join, as it was full. It was a map I didn't particularly like anyways, but after it was Quintus, and I really wanted to play it. But, sitting around spectating a match isn't very fun. As you could probally guess, I wanted to actually play, but not miss quintus.

Actual suggestion:  If we could somehow set an alarm of sorts, that when a match ends, it would send us a little message saying it ended, so we could go there and play the map we actually wanted to play. Now, I know there could be issues with this, and Im no coder, so I have no idea if you could even do this, but I think it would be an awesome addition to maximize the fun we can have on Avicus.


     Hope you take this into consideration one day,
                                                              -ReSync
